text: A large survey said cutting salt dropped office workers' blood pressure 11 points; daily walks help too.
I heard coffee may boost memory, though the test only used students after a sleepless night.
Three startup software teams said remote work raised productivity, but the gain faded after six months.
A new bridge cut bus commutes by about twenty minutes, compared with a year of major roadworks.
Someone said vitamin D prevents colds, per one supplement-funded winter trial of under-fives.
A reading app helped English-learning children read better than no teaching, but the gains faded by next year.
Pesticides harmed bumblebees: one season in two English counties left colonies with a quarter fewer queens.
An Icelandic trial found a four-day week on unchanged pay cut burnout, but sick days stayed the same.
